Advance city intimation slips are issued prior to the exam.

items.t: GATE 2027 (IIT Madras) — Application Rectification & Exam Schedule
items.x: Official GATE 2027 schedule announced by IIT Madras: Application rectification (scrutiny defects without fee) closes on November 30, 2026. Essential for M.Tech admissions and PSU CS recruitment.
